### Cause attribution is separate from failure response
After F0-F6 selects the permitted response, the cause chain must separately label every evidenced layer as rule defect, procedural amplification, tool defect, or agent non-compliance. A tool defect exists when implementation contradicts an adequate contract under compliant invocation. Agent non-compliance exists only when an adequate rule gives one unambiguous required or prohibited action, no higher conflict or tool failure prevents compliance, and evidence shows the agent chose the contrary action. Mixed chains retain all supported labels and identify the stable prevention boundary; an agent's evidenced violation of an adequate rule is never recast as a defect in that rule.[D][W]
